name: 恋爱泡馍！青春老陕：Shannxi Love Story
detailed_description:
Discover Chinese culture through a brand-new lens !

Shaanxi Province, known as the "Land of Qin," boasts a cultural heritage that has thrived through thirteen dynasties.

Its official English name, "Shaanxi," is derived from the local dialect's pronunciation, where the character "陕" (Shǎn) is pronounced with a fourth tone. To reflect this unique phonetic character, the spelling "Shannxi" is used, emphasizing the distinct intonation of the region.

The provincial capital, Xi'an, is a city where ancient charm meets youthful vitality. Home to numerous universities and a vibrant student population, Xi'an is a historical capital that seamlessly blends its millennia-old heritage with the energy of modern youth. The people of Shaanxi, embody the rich and diverse facets of life here, where the weight of history coexists with the fervor of new beginnings.

【About : Shannxi Love Story】

Shannxi Love Story is a visual novel-style game set against the backdrop of university life in Shaanxi, infused with local cultural flavors. After completing a year at a prestigious university in Xi'an, an unexpected event disrupts the protagonist's routine-driven life.

Amid the tranquil summer, under the shade of green phoenix trees, the story unfolds through themes of academic research, savoring paomo (a traditional Shaanxi dish), visits to the iconic Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, and the joys of video games. Over the course of this summer, the protagonist teams up with the mysterious campus idol "Xiao Xi" and four classmates, each with their own unique personalities and aspirations. Together, they explore the youthful spirit of Xi'an and discover the myriad possibilities life has to offer.

【Features】

  • Rediscover the Ancient Capital of Xi'an: Immerse yourself in the city's rich history and vibrant culture through beautifully illustrated scenes.

  • Explore a Historic University: Experience the youthful energy of a century-old prestigious institution.

  • Join Forces with Xiao Xi and Friends: Interact with the mysterious campus idol and a diverse cast of characters, each bringing their own stories and personalities to life.

"It's been a year since I started at this renowned university in Xi'an.

Graduate school admissions, job hunting, GPA, competitions, scholarships...

After crossing the finish line of the highly anticipated 'Gaokao'(National College Entrance Examination),  new goals have emerged.

Achieving a high GPA, participating in competitions, engaging in extracurricular activities, and earning scholarships have become my new benchmarks.

It's like an exhilarating game, filled with challenging tasks and enticing rewards.

But what if I fail at the very first checkpoint? Where do I go if I can't start over?"

【Demo Release】

The demo for Shannxi Love Story will be released in the first half of 2025!

  • Contact us: sense_science@outlook.com

  • Add to Your Wishlist: Get notified via email when the free demo is available!

About the Team:

Shannxi Love Story is the first project by a team of current university students.

Our goal is to capture and explore the authentic experiences of university life while conveying a message of hope and positivity through innovative storytelling.

Though we are still honing our skills and refining our work, we hope this humble game can bring you both joy and inspiration, reveal a different facet of modern Chinese culture to you.

We are committed to improving and moving forward, one step at a time.

Thank you for your support!

  • Writer/Planner: 战术深海

  • Development: 战术深海 / 萨卡萨卡班班 / K-OH

  • Art Director: 嘀哩礼理
